characters.name: Andre Laurent
characters.goal: Secure a career-saving three-star review from the dining critic

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Establishes Julien's discovery of Andre's theft and his resolve to witness Andre's downfall.

required_beats: Julien reads the gilded tasting menu at Table 4 and discovers his signature smoked quince tart claimed under Andre's exclusive name while noting the chief restaurant critic seated nearby.
Smelling burnt wood chips leaking from an overheated smoker past the kitchen doors, Julien recalls his exile from the industry.
Julien sets down his napkin and pledges to see Andre's name burned off the ticket before the final course clears the pass.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Reveals Andre's hidden vulnerability and protective demeanor toward his staff, complicating Julien's desire for revenge.
required_beats: Julien slips into the service area and observes Andre shielding a junior commis cook by absorbing the blame for a spilled glaze.
Behind the pass divider, Andre dry-swallows medication while his hands tremble violently against the stainless steel.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Resolves Julien's vendetta as he claims true ownership of the craft and lets go of his hatred.

char_andre.goal: Secure a career-saving three-star review from the dining critic

char_julien.goal: Enter the kitchen to ensure the quince dessert collapses before the critic

char_andre.goal: Prevent the critic's signature dessert from failing at the pass

char_julien.goal: Build his own craft away from his mentor's shadow

required_beats: Julien confronts Andre at the pastry line as the critic's quince tart begins to liquefy and Andre's trembling fingers fail to steady the plating tongs.
Julien sears Andre's printed name off the VIP service ticket using the station blowtorch.
Julien stabilizes the smoke emulsion with cold cream, finishes the spun-sugar dome, and sends the flawless plate to the critic before walking out into the alley.

voice_card.narrative_distance: close third, pressed against the protagonist
voice_card.register: grave, ornate, foreboding; dwells where a plainer voice would move on
voice_card.sentence_rhythm: long accreting sentences broken by a short one that lands like a door
voice_card.dialogue_density: low; speech arrives rarely and carries weight when it does
voice_card.reader_familiarity: The first time a deep term appears (domain-specific jargon), let dialogue or narration make its meaning clear within a clause. Never lecture.

metadata.title: The Smoke and the Quince
metadata.source: segmented from a Fabula-only package by gemini-3.8-flash

facts.statement: Andre took sole credit for Julien's signature smoked quince dessert recipe.
Andre used his influence with dining syndicates to ensure Julien could not secure a head pastry position.
The kitchen smoking apparatus ran too hot, destabilizing the pectin matrix of the quince tart.
Julien swore to see Andre's name burned off the ticket before the final course cleared the pass.
Andre developed severe nerve tremors in his hands that made fine pastry assembly impossible under pressure.

premise.logline: A chef who was blacklisted by his mentor finally gets a table at the mentor’s restaurant on the night it is being reviewed.

modules.theme: what we owe the people who made us and then unmade us
modules.setting_time: a single service night, with years of history behind it
modules.setting_place: an acclaimed restaurant kitchen and dining room
modules.protagonist: a line cook who once ran that kitchen’s pastry section
modules.protagonist_want: to see his mentor fail in front of the critic
modules.antagonism: the mentor, older now, and frightened
modules.complication: the dish that ruined him is on tonight’s menu, credited to the mentor
modules.ending_shape: he could ruin the night, and what he does instead is the answer

plot_shape.name: Reckoning
plot_shape.central_question: Does the debt get collected, and does collecting it help?

phases.name: The injury
phases.purpose: The original wrong, shown rather than reported.

phases.name: The vow
phases.purpose: A commitment made in a state the maker will not always be in.

phases.name: Preparation
phases.purpose: Means acquired, allies made and used, a self narrowed to a purpose.

phases.name: Contact
phases.purpose: The wrongdoer, close enough to be seen as a person.

phases.name: Aftermath
phases.purpose: What is left of the avenger once the purpose is gone.

cast_roles.purpose: Holds the debt and is deformed by holding it.
Committed the wrong, and has a life that does not look like a villain's.
Helps the claimant for reasons of their own.
Argues for the cost, and is not simply right.

obligatory_moves: The vow is made with a specific, quotable condition attached.
The debtor is shown doing something that is not villainous before contact.
The aftermath addresses the vow's exact wording.

events.summary: Julien reviews tonight's tasting menu at Table 4 and discovers his stolen smoked quince recipe featured under Andre's exclusive name.
events.dramatic_function: Confronts the claimant with the raw injury of his stolen work presented on review night.
beats: Julien reads the gilded tasting menu and finds his signature smoked quince tart claimed solely by Andre.
He notes the chief restaurant critic seated two tables away preparing for the dessert flight.
He catches the acrid smell of burnt wood chips leaking past the kitchen doors, noticing the smoker is running too hot.

events.summary: Julien commits himself to witnessing Andre's public ruin at the pass before the final dessert is served.
events.dramatic_function: Articulates the claimant's exact vow and narrowing purpose.
beats: Julien remembers being cast out of the industry when Andre told owners across the city that Julien was unstable.
He sets down his napkin and pledges his vow: 'I will see his name burned off that ticket before the final course clears the pass.'

state_changes.value: Enter the kitchen to ensure the quince dessert collapses before the critic

events.summary: Julien slips into the service area and observes Andre shielding a flustered junior commis while hiding his own severe hand tremor.
events.dramatic_function: Humanizes the debtor by showing his quiet decency and physical vulnerability before direct contact.
beats: Julien steps through the swing doors and watches Andre calmly absorb the blame for a commis cook's spilled glaze.
He watches Andre step behind the pass divider to dry-swallow medication as his hands tremble violently against the stainless steel.

events.summary: Julien confronts Andre at the pastry line as the critic's quince tart begins to separate from the scorched smoke infusion.
events.dramatic_function: Brings claimant and debtor into direct confrontation over the failing dish.
beats: Andre turns, recognizes his ruined apprentice standing over the pastry pass, and freezes in shock.
The quince pectin begins to weep and liquefy because the overheated hay smoke ruined the gelatin matrix.
Andre reaches out with trembling plating tongs to salvage the tart, visibly unable to steady his fingers.

state_changes.value: Prevent the critic's signature dessert from failing at the pass

events.summary: Julien takes the station blowtorch to sear Andre's name off the VIP ticket, stabilizes the dessert with cold emulsion, and leaves the kitchen unburdened.
events.dramatic_function: Fulfills the exact wording of the vow while releasing the claimant from his consuming vengeance.
beats: Julien takes the culinary torch, ignites it, and burns Andre's printed name off the VIP service ticket.
Using his steady hands, Julien blends cold cream to rescue the smoke emulsion and completes the delicate spun-sugar dome.
Julien sets the flawless plate on the runner's tray for the critic and walks out into the alley, leaving his hatred behind.
